{"ascii":"Live Canvas Agent API
|-- Tool entry -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|   |-- MCP server (infrastructure/mapping/mcp/server.ts)
|   |   |-- Stdio tools -> POST /api/mapping/agent/tools/{name} -> JSON result
|   |   |-- Unbound client: canvas.list -> canvas.attach -> sessionId
|   |   |-- Configured canvas/document: lazily attach and inject sessionId
|   |   `-- Chat binding: capture the turn's target; reject a different canvas binding
|   |-- Session identity = canvasId + documentId + optional changeSessionId
|   |   |-- Live attachment checks the registered document and reads browser identity
|   |   `-- Proposal attachment must match changeSessionId on subsequent calls
|   |-- Validate tool schemas and enforce read-only access
|   |   `-- exec also checks each invoked method; diagram submissions require write access
|   `-- Request identity and recovery
|       |-- Cache request signature + promise within tool/session/proposal scope
|       |-- Same requestId + changed arguments -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|       |-- Timeout or rejected/oversized canvas reply -> allow identical retry
|       `-- Pure exec read results are released; mutation receipts remain cached
|-- Live commands -> owning browser
|   |-- CanvasSessionBridge (infrastructure/mapping/agent/canvasSessionBridge.ts)
|   |   |-- register: retain descriptor and refresh liveness
|   |   |-- dispatch: assign command ID, enqueue for canvasId, await matching reply
|   |   |   |-- Browser poll drains queue; empty poll waits up to 15 seconds
|   |   |   |-- Reply must match pending command ID and canvasId
|   |   |   `-- 25-second timeout -> outcome may be unknown; retry same requestId
|   |   `-- Unregister or stale registration -> reject pending commands
|   |-- useAgentCanvasBridge (src/features/mapping/agent/useAgentCanvasBridge.ts)
|   |   |-- Register ephemeral canvasId with browser stableWorkspaceId
|   |   |-- Poll -> handle(command) -> encode canvasReply -> POST reply
|   |   |   |-- Cache up to 200 mutation results by command ID
|   |   |   `-- Rejected reply -> report CANVAS_REPLY_REJECTED to pending caller
|   |   `-- Reconnect after failure; unregister on pagehide and React cleanup
|   `-- Service dispatches document-scoped operations
|       |-- identity / read / snapshot -> current browser state
|       |-- apply -> semantic operations + expectedVersion + requestId
|       |-- apply-diagram-revision / create-diagrams / apply-diagram-batch
|       `-- checkpoint / saved / canvas-view / apply-diagram-context
|-- exec -> constrained JavaScript + semantic canvas methods
|   |-- QuickJsAgentRuntime (infrastructure/mapping/agent/execRuntime.ts)
|   |   |-- Frozen canvas, nodes and edges method groups -> validated host calls
|   |   |-- 32 MiB memory; 512 KiB stack; 30-second deadline and interrupt limit
|   |   |-- At most 100 API calls; 4 MiB limit per API result and final result
|   |   `-- Dispose runtime context on every exit
|   |-- Reads
|   |   |-- canvas.read -> current-state read + aliases scoped to session binding
|   |   |-- nodes.list/get and edges.list -> display nodes and edges through [A]
|   |   `-- Lazy snapshots must match execution version or fail VERSION_CONFLICT
|   |-- Mutations
|   |   |-- Require expectedVersion to match initial execution version
|   |   |-- Resolve aliases and compact anchors before freezing an operation
|   |   |-- Immediate mode: apply one operation -> advance tracked version
|   |   `-- Batched mode: queue operations and return IDs with status=queued
|   |       |-- Flush before reads, canvas methods, source mappings and jumps
|   |       |-- Flush remaining operations when script returns
|   |       `-- Each flush returns mutation receipts; one exec can contain multiple batches
|   `-- Uncertain execution -> replay with identical code, arguments and requestId
|       |-- Retain step signatures, outcomes, generated IDs and batch versions
|       |-- Replay completed API results; resend only unacknowledged work
|       |-- Changed step or batch sequence -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|       `-- A script catching a transport timeout does not make the execution complete
|-- Related operations (application/mapping/agent/sessionService.ts)
|   |-- Diagram generation -> DiagramEditService / DiagramBatchService
|   |   |-- Prompt edit/create/extend -> runId -> status or cancellation
|   |   |-- Chat-bound direct submission -> start batch and wait for result
|   |   `-- Apply generated work through browser revision/create/batch commands
|   |-- Proposal work -> ChangeSessionService
|   |   |-- changeSessionId routes descriptors, snapshots and apply to proposal documents
|   |   |-- Search/read baseline or proposed content; project migration anchors through [A]
|   |   `-- Create/update/accept are explicit tools; save_diagram rejects proposal publishing
|   |-- Contexts
|   |   |-- Saved library: create, fork, comment, lineage, update, list and read
|   |   |-- Generation may resolve a saved or workspace/document-bound context
|   |   `-- Diagram-bound context: read / prepare / delete
|   |       |-- Read reports absent, ready or stale using source fingerprint
|   |       |-- Prepare/delete require current document version and diagram revision
|   |       `-- Store prepared evidence; retain browser-application payload for retry
|   |-- Diagram search -> live attachment, pinned proposal or saved catalog
|   |   `-- Search text, content nodes or code references; read complete diagrams
|   `-- Save live diagram/document -> serialize saves per canvas/document
|       |-- Whole document: browser checkpoint -> publish checkpoint -> notify browser
|       |-- Single diagram: isolate scene, rebase metadata -> save representation
|       `-- Publication may succeed while display notification fails: displayUpdated=false
|-- Live selection connections -> LiveCanvasService
|   |-- Separate from tool sessionId and HTTP command polling
|   |   |-- /api/mapping/live WebSocket first frame: publish or attach
|   |   |-- Publisher binds registered workspaceInstanceId to its owning socket
|   |   `-- Reader connectionId binds workspaceInstanceId + documentId + canvasEpoch
|   |-- Selection mirror (application/mapping/agent/liveCanvasService.ts)
|   |   |-- Publisher sends full snapshot or delta
|   |   |-- Ignore old/duplicate sequence within the same epoch
|   |   |-- Delta requires matching epoch and baseSequence; otherwise resnapshot
|   |   |-- Validate unique regions, whole-diagram IDs and payload bounds
|   |   `-- Matching readers receive selection.delta; publisher receives agents.changed
|   |-- Connection lifetime
|   |   |-- Document epoch changes -> canvas.replaced
|   |   |-- Document removed -> canvas.closed
|   |   |-- Publisher disconnects -> canvas.disconnected
|   |   `-- Invalidate bound readers and pending copy/paste; rediscover before retrying
|   |-- Read selection and context (src/server/routes/mapping/liveCanvasRoutes.ts)
|   |   |-- HTTP selection: epoch, sequence, version, receipt time + ETag/304
|   |   |-- attach(includeContext) or context.get -> load authoritative canvas context
|   |   |   `-- Recheck publisher/epoch after await; project nodes and edges through [A]
|   |   |-- Short context HTTP read: workspace/document target + epoch/version headers
|   |   `-- Slow WebSocket reader -> close and reconnect for authoritative snapshot
|   `-- Reader commands -> publisher socket -> owning browser
|       |-- diagram.copy / diagram.paste require enabled canvas writes
|       |-- agent-context.upload requires enabled uploads and a valid reader binding
|       |-- Copy requires publisher capability; paste carries expectedVersion and fixed nodeId
|       `-- Copy/paste receipts keyed by workspace + document + epoch + requestId
|           |-- Changed arguments -> REQUEST_ID_REUSED
|           |-- Timeout -> retain command identity; identical retry resends if unacknowledged
|           |-- Paste success must return assigned nodeId and expectedVersion + 1
|           `-- Never evict receipts; reject new work when receipt capacity is reached
`-- [A] CanvasApiProjection: compact anchors across tools and live contexts
    |-- application/mapping/agent/apiProjection.ts
    |-- Backend-lifetime mapping: full content-node ID <-> @generation.scope:counter
    |   |-- Scope includes revision/hash prefix; opaque IDs get their own scope
    |   |-- Handles are never evicted or reassigned
    |   `-- Unknown compact handle -> STALE_CONTENT_NODE; full-ID callers remain valid
    |-- Output projection
    |   |-- Content tree roots, parents, children and node IDs
    |   |-- Collapsible subtrees, highlights, jumps, edges and migrations
    |   `-- Strip grid rendering internals and duplicate content; add apiFormatVersion
    `-- Input resolution restores full IDs before domain operations
        `-- Domain state retains full identity; backend restart requires rereading handles"}
